title: Road design and dimension standards used by Road Builder
note: Every entry names its source and section. status: verified = read in the primary text; verified-secondary = read in a state design manual that applies or reproduces a federal guide (the primary was not available); unverified = from general knowledge or not found, do not present as a standard. Values are the standard's own units (us) with a metric conversion (si, metres or metres per second). The code field records how the plug-in's own constant compares (conforms true, false or null when not comparable). Widths in the plug-in's library are typical values, not surveyed ones.

mutcd.title: Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices for Streets and Highways, 11th Edition (December 2023) with Revision 1 incorporated (December 2025)
mutcd.note: Official current edition. Quotes are verbatim from the PDF text; page numbers are the MUTCD's own.

prowag.title: Accessibility Guidelines for Pedestrian Facilities in the Public Right-of-Way (PROWAG), Chapter R3 Technical Requirements
prowag.note: Web edition of the technical requirements.

fdot212.title: FDOT Design Manual, Chapter 212 Intersections (topic 625-000-002, January 1, 2018)
fdot212.note: A state manual (not federal). Used for the numbers the MUTCD leaves to design guides. The 2018 edition is old; check the current FDM before relying on a value.

scdot_rbt.title: SCDOT Roundabout Design Criteria (Figure 9.7-A to D)
scdot_rbt.note: States that it follows NCHRP Report 672 (Roundabouts: An Informational Guide, 2nd ed.); the primary text could not be read (see sources_blocked).

wisdot_1126.title: WisDOT Facilities Development Manual 11-26 Roundabouts
wisdot_1126.note: Cites NCHRP Report 1043 (2023) for its Table 8.1.

sources_blocked.what: FHWA Roundabouts: An Informational Guide (FHWA-SA-10-006) and the 2013 FHWA Signalized Intersections Informational Guide (FHWA-SA-13-027)
sources_blocked.tried: safety.fhwa.dot.gov and highways.dot.gov return HTTP 403 to automated downloads; nap.nationalacademies.org chapter pages serve page images with no text; onlinepubs.trb.org returned an HTML page instead of the PDF
sources_blocked.action: Not worked around. Download by hand and drop the PDFs in a scratch folder, then add entries citing the section numbers.

sources_blocked.what: AASHTO A Policy on Geometric Design of Highways and Streets (Green Book), Guide for the Development of Bicycle Facilities, Roadside Design Guide
sources_blocked.tried: not fetched: copyrighted and sold by AASHTO
sources_blocked.action: Cite by name and section only if the owner supplies a licensed copy. Values attributed to the Green Book elsewhere (lane width, kerb radius) stay unverified here.

The NTSB investigates accidents, studies safety and recommends changes; its mission page does not describe design standards. Its highway reports cite the MUTCD and AASHTO for the standards. Individual reports can be cited as case evidence, not as a source of dimensions.
